summary: PULSARA is a web app that helps astronauts track their own health during long space missions. They enter a quick daily check-in, and the app compares each reading with their personal baseline to show a clear status: Stable, Attention, or Medical review. A clickable body map links the five space hazards to the body systems they affect and explains what to do next. It also gives trend charts, simple insights from their own data, and a report to share with the flight surgeon. This matters because on missions to the Moon and Mars, help will be delayed, so crews need to spot health changes early and act on their own first.
